1.support: The aim was to report measures of partitioned respiratory mechanics under lung-protective MV at different PEEP levels in patients with AE-ILD-UIP compared with ARDS.

2.support: Inclusion criteria were age > 18 years; established diagnosis of ILD with a UIP pattern on a high-resolution computed tomography scan; invasive MV in volume-controlled mode.

3.support: Patients with AE-ILD-UIP developing AHRF and consecutively admitted to the RICU (August 1st, 2016, to July 1st, 2022) were eligible for enrollment.

4.support: Over the study period a total of 21 patients with AE-ILD-UIP underwent MV. Of these, 10 patients were analyzed according to inclusion criteria.

5.support: We searched for a sample size calculation, power statement or justification of the number enrolled and found none; only 10 patients per group were analyzed.
5.location: Whole report; 'Our study suffers from limitations: the small sample' (page 4, Discussion)

6.support: patients with AE-ILD-UIP or ARDS requiring MV were submitted to a partitioned respiratory mechanics measurements within 24 h from admission during three different lung-protective strategies including low VT (6 ml/Kg/PBW) and three consecutive PEEP levels

7.support: At each phase, PEEP level was maintained for 30 min before recording all respiratory parameters and arterial blood sampling
7.location: Page 2, 'Study procedures and aim'; Table 1, page 3

8.support: We looked for any statement that outcome assessors were blinded to PEEP phase or group and found none; the same investigative team applied the PEEP levels and recorded the outcomes.
8.location: Page 2, 'Study procedures and aim' and 'Data collection and analysis plan'

9.support: Measurements were performed within 24 h of admission at three consecutive PEEP phases in the same patients, with all 10 enrolled patients contributing data at each phase (Table 1, Fig. 1); no participant dropped out.
9.location: Page 2, 'Study procedures and aim'; Table 1, page 3

10.support: Comparison between continuous variables was performed with Wilcoxon and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests.

11.support: The design was a single pre-intervention measurement series across three PEEP phases within 24 h, not an interrupted time-series with repeated measures before and after the intervention.

12.support: The PEEP-titration intervention was applied at the individual patient level, not at a group level.

nih.rationale: The rating is driven down by No answers on item 4 (only 10 of 21 eligible patients analyzed), item 5 (small sample with no power justification), item 8 (no blinding of outcome assessors) and item 11 (no time-series design). Strengths include a clearly stated question, prespecified eligibility criteria, a well-described and consistently delivered physiological intervention, objective and reliably assessed outcomes, complete follow-up over the short study period, and appropriate paired statistical tests with p values, which prevent a Poor rating.
